TITLE: Schedule – Dropped Shift Is Saved Six Hours After the Hour It Was Dropped On
TYPE: Story Defect · PARENT: SV-10047 (Ready for QA, read 10 Oct 2026 — my reading of the owning story; regression item, confirm) · PRIORITY: Medium · LABEL: board-tech-view
MY READING: REAL DEFECT on this branch. RELATED (QA lead to decide whether it belongs here): on the Timesheets list a clock-in made minutes ago shows six hours ahead (10:01 AM when the shop's time was ~4:01 AM), and editing it is refused with 'Start date cannot be set in the future. Please try to resolve this.' (C368177, S10043-18865; SV-11087 covers that test's line move). RULE 121 CHECK (12 Oct 2026, twice each): production with its test location set to America/Edmonton (this branch's zone) saved a 1 PM drop as 13:00–15:00, exactly where dropped => the six-hour jump is NOT on production => REGRESSION. Separate, pre-existing on production: with the location on its own zone Africa/Bangui (UTC+1) the same drop saved 12:00–14:00, one hour early (not a regression; reported, not filed). OWNING STORY OPEN: SV-10047 read live 12 Oct = Ready for QA but it is 'Reassign or unassign the lead technician', not the Schedule drag — ask the QA lead which story to parent under. Picture is 1x — recapture at 2x before filing (Rule 116).

h2. Description

A shift made by dragging a work order onto the *Schedule* should start at the hour it is dropped on.

For example,
* dropped under *1 PM* on a technician's row, the shift is saved as *07:00 PM – 09:00 PM*
* dropped under *9 AM* as the whole work order, the shift is saved as *03:00 PM – 05:00 PM*

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Click *Schedule* in the top menu and click the *>* arrow next to *Today* to go to a working day.
# In *Search work orders* (left) type a work order that has estimated hours left, and find its card.
# Drag the card onto a technician's row and drop it under *1 PM*.
# In the window, click *Choose lines*, tick one line, set *Hours* to *2h* and click *Create shift · 1 line · 2h*.
#* *Shift scheduled.* shows, with no error.
# Reload the page, go to the same day and click the new shift on that row.

*Actual Result:*
* The shift's *TIME* reads *07:00 PM – 09:00 PM* and it is drawn under *7 PM*.

*Expected Result:*
* The shift reads *1:00 PM – 3:00 PM* and is drawn under *1 PM*, where it was dropped.
